gradient_hessian.construction: central finite difference of the exact held-endpoint conservative free-material gradient, followed by explicit symmetrization
gradient_hessian.spectrum: dense symmetric eigendecomposition for the 240-dimensional frozen production preparation
requirements: all eigenvalues and matrices are finite
the minimum eigenvalue at every step is not below negative hessian_tolerance_N_per_m
the tolerance-aware minimum-eigenvalue class is identical at all three steps
the raw sign of the minimum eigenvalue is identical at all three steps
the base-step minimum eigenvalue agrees with the preparation audit within ten hessian tolerances

independent_energy_directional_probe.direction: the normalized minimum-eigenvalue direction from the base-step gradient Hessian
independent_energy_directional_probe.construction: central second difference of conservative energy at the same three displacement magnitudes
requirements: every directional curvature is not below negative hessian_tolerance_N_per_m
the tolerance-aware curvature class is identical at all three displacement magnitudes
the raw sign of directional curvature is identical at all three displacement magnitudes

condition_number.definition: maximum absolute eigenvalue divided by the minimum absolute eigenvalue strictly above the unchanged hessian tolerance
condition_number.role: reported diagnostic across alpha; no new arbitrary acceptance threshold is introduced
condition_number.fail_closed: non-finite spectrum or absence of any resolved stiffness is a preparation failure

claim_boundary: Passing this check supports only the numerical identity of a prepared candidate minimum. It does not prove trajectory convergence, a unilateral-string limit or apparatus validity.
